title: Frontend: Auto Save Text
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Auto Save Text. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A controlled Draft textarea debounces acknowledgement by 40 ms after the latest change. Initial status is Ready. Edits show Unsaved immediately; after idle display Saved and echo acknowledged text in [data-testid="saved"]. Clean up the timer on changes/unmount. This uses an in-memory acknowledgement, not durable/cloud storage.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep the editable draft separate from the last acknowledged revision.
alternativeApproaches: Retry failed saves and reconcile an external edit without silently overwriting either draft.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Rapid typing; idle save; storage failure.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
